Patriots Players Gonzalez and Barmore Out for Bills Game

New England Patriots players Christian Gonzalez and Christian Barmore will not play in the upcoming game against the Buffalo Bills. Coach Mike Vrabel also discussed the shoulder injury of Drake Maye. Gonzalez spoke about the Patriots' offense and the upcoming game against the Bills, as well as a recent partnership.
